title: Sunday · the one firework, after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Eight days after the Fourth: the dock, the single spent tube standing in a coffee can, the lawn chair, and the girl of ten looking at the tube like an object. The last tier the bay, nothing on it.
